title: BBUL
summary: Identity for BBUL, a relay drawing project by 16 artists.
credits:
Artists: GuNa, Camelostrich, Cho Leesop, Chae Soojin, Choi Heewon, Han Goeun, Hong Yejin, Jeong Duldol, Jiiho, Kim Dohyeon, Kim Jane Kyuwon, Kim Haerri, Lee Yujin, Lee Yewon, Na Junheum, Noh Hyejin
Graphic Design: Junyeol Baek
Object Design: Hyejin Noh
Space Design: Philjae Kim
Photography: [Dohyun Park](https://www.instagram.com/dhyvnpark/)
description: BBUL ('horn' in Korean) is a relay drawing project conducted by 16 artists. Over one weekend the artists took turns drawing in the space, one each hour; the following weekend the drawings were shown together.
